usedFor: Fibery holds your work entities, and Instagram for Business publishes through “Post Video or Reel”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Entity” in Fibery, then “Post Video or Reel” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A new entity in a chosen Fibery app can publish a video or Reel to your business account.

watchOut: “New Entity” in Fibery is polling, so posts go out after a scheduled check, not on creation.
